control_contract.ring_submission_disabled: The generated BPF program retains target filtering, active-marker admission, task-storage lookup, in-flight accounting, and unique-edge diagnostic coverage. It omits ring-buffer reservation, payload construction, and submission.
control_contract.observation_contract: A disabled arm must retain zero syscall observations and zero resolved syscalls; it is never usable as Tier E evidence.

interpretation.supported: Real ring submission and collector resolution account for a material amount of the measured session phase time. Dictionary serialization and lock wait are not isolated by this control and must not be inferred from it.
interpretation.not_supported: The paired workload and elapsed deltas are high variance and do not establish an end-to-end application slowdown or a ranking between emission modes.
interpretation.next_measurement: Use this control with an improved steady-state workload and per-event ring-reader component timing before optimizing the ring path.
